packs.title: Driving Practice Batch C v0.1 (British modular street scenery)
packs.author: Made for the project owner (procedurally modelled original geometry and texture atlas; build scripts in the pack's source/)
packs.source: Driving_Practice_Batch_C_Complete.zip supplied by the project owner, received 2026-10-19 (28 GLBs, previews, manifest, validation report, source scripts)
packs.licence: Project-owned original work: the pack README states the models and atlas were procedurally created with no third-party geometry or images. The owner confirmed on 2026-10-19 that their supplied packs may be used in the published app and this public repository.
contents: 12 buildings (high-street shops including Boots- and Tesco Express-style fronts, corner shop, cafe, pub, two-unit row, brick and buff terraced houses, low-rise flats, supermarket frontage, office, pharmacy)
9 road and pavement pieces (pavement, dropped kerb, corner, road section, give-way line, mini-roundabout island, double yellows, parking bays, refuge island)
7 furniture items (lamppost, street tree, planter, roadworks barrier, traffic cone, postbox, hanging sign)
packs.notes: Shipped: the street tree only. Buildings and road pieces are fixed-size generic modules, while the scenes build both from mapped footprints and road geometry; the Boots/Tesco-style signs raise brand questions. The lamppost matches the drawn lamp column. Postbox, planter, cone, barrier and hanging sign have no mapped positions or scenario yet. See docs/assets/batch-c.md.

packs.title: Driving Practice Batch D v0.2 (detail upgrade: branded roadside buildings, taxi, e-bike, station entrance)
packs.author: Made for the project owner (procedurally built geometry and sign textures; build and render scripts in the pack's source/)
packs.source: Driving_Practice_Batch_D_Detail_Upgrade_Complete.zip supplied by the project owner, received 2026-10-20 (12 GLBs, 20 sign textures, previews, manifest, structural QA, source scripts)
packs.licence: Project-owned original work per the pack README (brand text and colours are approximate interpretations, not traced logos). The brand names and colours themselves are trademarks of their owners: the project owner chose on 2026-10-20 to show them; no affiliation or endorsement is claimed (stated in the About panel).
contents: Esso forecourt; Lidl, Aldi, Asda, Sainsbury's, Tesco Extra and Tesco Express stores; KFC and McDonald's restaurants
TX-style black cab; Lime-style rental e-bike; London Underground-style station entrance (Embankment)
20 sign textures (brand lettering on brand colours)
packs.storage: not stored: no file from the pack is in this repository
packs.notes: Used: the sign styles (lettering, colours, weight) of the KFC, McDonald's, Tesco Express and Sainsbury's textures, reproduced in code (src/world/brandSigns.ts) and drawn on the fascia of a building whose OpenStreetMap name is exactly that business (Brentwood High Street area: KFC, McDonald's, Tesco Express; the mapped Sainsbury's store has no wall facing a road, so no sign). The GLB buildings are not placed: they are fixed-size standalone stores, while the scenes draw buildings from their mapped outlines, and none of the other businesses (Esso, Lidl, Aldi, Asda, Tesco Extra) is mapped in the current areas. The Underground entrance is not used (no Underground in Brentwood). The taxi and e-bike are kept for later (not yet placed).

packs.title: Driving Practice Animated Tripo People (five rigged, animated characters)

packs.source: Driving_Practice_Animated_Tripo_People.zip (5 animated GLBs, previews, clip catalogue) and Driving_Practice_Tripo_Original_Source_Exports.zip (5 unmodified Tripo FBX exports), supplied by the project owner, received 2026-10-20
packs.licence: The project owner confirmed on 2026-10-20 that they hold a commercial licence to use these characters and their animations, including in this public repository and the published app.
contents: pedestrian_male_01 and pedestrian_male_02 (Walk, Idle, LookLeft, LookRight, SeatedIdle)
pedestrian_woman_04 (also Carrying a bag) and pedestrian_adult_05 (also Climbing)
action_performer_03 (12 clips including Cycling, run and greet_01; no Walk)
packs.storage: public: the four pedestrians, rebuilt smaller (below); the pack archives are not stored
packs.notes: Not used: action_performer_03 (no Walk clip; its Cycling clip is body motion with no bicycle), SeatedIdle and the other extra clips, and the FBX exports. The supplied GLBs' texture coordinates are flipped vertically (FBX convention), which shows as a patchwork of texture pieces; the build flips them back.
